Best Bars in South Yarra 2026

South Yarra’s bar scene continues to evolve, offering everything from sophisticated wine bars to energetic cocktail lounges. As one of Melbourne’s most dynamic suburbs, South Yarra attracts both locals and visitors seeking quality drinks and memorable experiences.

Venue Addresses & Details

  • Bar Carolina — 44 Toorak Rd, South Yarra VIC 3141 ($$$). Open: Mon-Sun 12:00 PM - 11:00 PM. Tip: Grab a seat at the marble bar for the best view of the cocktail preparation.
  • The Botanical — 169 Domain Rd, South Yarra VIC 3141 ($$$). Open: Mon-Sun 12:00 PM - 12:00 AM. Tip: The wine list is extensive; ask the sommelier for a recommendation from the local Victorian regions.
  • Two Wrongs — 637 Chapel St, South Yarra VIC 3141 ($$). Open: Tue-Thu 5:00 PM - 1:00 AM, Fri-Sat 5:00 PM - 3:00 AM. Tip: Arrive before 9:00 PM on weekends to avoid the long queue at the door.
  • Temperance Hotel — 426 Chapel St, South Yarra VIC 3141 ($$). Open: Mon-Sun 12:00 PM - 1:00 AM. Tip: The outdoor seating area is perfect for people-watching on Chapel Street.
  • Jack & Jill — 365 Chapel St, South Yarra VIC 3141 ($$). Open: Wed-Sun 5:00 PM - 1:00 AM. Tip: Try their signature espresso martini; it is widely considered one of the best in the area.

The Bottom End

Starting with a classic, The Bottom End at 1A Little Chapel Street, South Yarra VIC 3141, remains a cornerstone of the local bar scene. This unpretentious venue has been serving up cold beers and hearty pub fare for years. The outdoor beer garden is particularly popular during warmer months, offering a relaxed atmosphere where you can catch up with friends over a pot or two.

A Sophisticated Melbourne Enclave

Located just a stone’s throw from the Melbourne CBD, South Yarra (postcode 3141) is a sophisticated inner-city suburb renowned for its stunning Victorian architecture, upscale fashion boutiques, and refined dining experiences. South Yarra perfectly balances high-end living with easy access to some of Melbourne’s premier outdoor spaces and cultural attractions.
